description: This file contains TypeScript code for integrating with VS Code's language features, including definition, signature help, and symbol providers, with caching mechanisms and AST parsing utilities.

methods.name: executeSignatureHelpProvider
methods.description: Executes VS Code's signature help command with caching.

methods.name: executeGotoProvider
methods.description: Executes VS Code's goto definition commands with caching.

methods.name: getDefinitionsFromLsp
methods.description: Retrieves code definitions from the LSP based on cursor position and AST analysis.

methods.name: executeSymbolProvider
methods.description: Executes VS Code's document symbol provider with caching.
